# Edulab attribution

MAIS contains modified TypeScript rewrites of selected mathematical modules
from [wy51ai/edulab](https://github.com/wy51ai/edulab) at commit
`cf0bc1d68b4ea64307f57d7fac64667e6a3148cc`, licensed under Apache-2.0.

The public copies of the upstream license and notice are available as
[LICENSE.txt](./LICENSE.txt) and [NOTICE.txt](./NOTICE.txt). The authoritative
repository attribution and modification statement are maintained in
`third_party/edulab/`.
